name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script, and ran it. The API call succeeded and generated a valid 43KB MP3 audio file (44.1kHz, 128kbps, mono, ~2.69s duration) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." The file was verified with both the `file` command and `ffmpeg`.
deviations: Replaced `play(audio)` with `save(audio, "/home/daytona/output.mp3")` because the sandbox has no audio output device (no speakers/MPV). The core API request and text-to-speech generation followed the quickstart exactly.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural

friction.where: Quickstart default code assumes local audio playback
friction.detail: The sample uses play(audio) which requires mpv, but mpv is not found in the sandbox, forcing a rewrite to save().
Fetching the quickstart URL returns raw HTML with navigation menus rather than a clean markdown/code view, making it harder to extract the exact snippet.
